title: Analysis code and data: applying a Bayesian priority-action score to India's drug-resistant tuberculosis surveillance, 2017-2024
description:
Complete analysis code, input data and outputs for a study applying a Bayesian priority-action score to India's drug-resistant tuberculosis (DR-TB) surveillance over 2017-2024.

Surveillance data. Five national DR-TB axes reconstructed from the World Health Organization Global TB Programme country data for India (notifications, treatment outcomes, drug-resistance surveillance and burden-estimate datasets, retrieved 8 September 2026). data/ntep_trajectories.csv carries, for every datapoint, its numerator, its denominator, the WHO field names it was derived from and its source dataset, so each value is traceable to a published field rather than to a summary table.

Literature data. data/tb_interventions_unified.csv is a 3,589-record open-access harvest (twelve Boolean queries, one per pre-specified intervention node, against PubMed E-utilities and Europe PMC, 20 May 2026).

Code. code/build_tb_bopas_ijtb.py fits the trajectories with bootstrap and t-based intervals, segments them at documented reporting breaks, codes the corpus with a corrected direction-of-effect classifier, computes the score, and emits six sensitivity scenarios. It is pure-Python 3.11 with no third-party numerical dependency; the incomplete beta function is evaluated by continued fraction and inverted by bisection, and verification/test_beta_bound.py checks that implementation and every published credible bound against SciPy.

Verification. The scripts under verification/ re-check word counts, keyword rules, citation sequence, blinding and every reported number against the pipeline outputs. Those under validation/ build and analyse a stratified 150-record worksheet for validating the automated classifier against independent human coding.

Principal finding. No axis of India's DR-TB surveillance is significantly worsening over the period; treatment success improved by +4.23 (MDR/RR-TB) and +6.38 (XDR-TB) percentage points per year. The score returns no urgent priority. Fitting across an uncorrected 2021 reporting discontinuity is sufficient on its own to manufacture a confident top-ranked priority on an axis that is in fact improving.
